2607.14962.title: Multi-Axis Max@K Reinforcement Learning for Representative Diversity in Text-to-Image Generation
2607.14962.paper_summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models can synthesize realistic, prompt-aligned images, yet samples generated for the same prompt often cover only a small subset of visually distinct modes. This limits the diversity of images, and for person-centric prompts, can reflect or amplify demographic skew. We formalize this problem as coverage of a predefined set of semantically specified modes, which we call target-mode coverage. We then propose multi-axis max@K, a group-based reinforcement learning objective for improving such coverage in diffusion-based T2I models. Given a group of samples and one score per target category, multi-axis max@K first takes the maximum score across samples for each category and then sums these category-wise maxima. The resulting credit assignment gives a sample positive weight on a category only when it increases that category's group-wise maximum, allowing different samples to contribute to different categories. We first validate the credit-assignment mechanism on a synthetic mixture and on SD3.5-M using deterministic pixel-based color rewards. We then evaluate the same objective on perceived-appearance fairness. Across three automatic evaluators on held-out prompts, multi-axis max@K improves the Fairness Score by 0.23-0.36 relative to the base model, while maintaining image quality and text alignment.
2607.14962.paper_summary_zh: 文本到圖像（T2I）模型可以合成現實且與提示對齊的圖像，但對於相同提示生成的樣本通常僅涵蓋視覺上不同模式的小子集。這限制了圖像的多樣性，對於以人為中心的提示，可能會反映或放大人口統計偏差。我們將這個問題形式化為對預定義的語義指定模式的覆蓋，我們稱之為目標模式覆蓋。然後，我們提出了多軸 max@K，這是一種基於群體的強化學習目標，用於改善擴散基 T2I 模型中的這種覆蓋。給定一組樣本和每個目標類別的一個分數，多軸 max@K 首先對每個類別在樣本中取最大分數，然後將這些類別的最大值相加。結果的信用分配僅在樣本提高該類別的群體最大值時，給予該類別正權重，允許不同樣本對不同類別做出貢獻。我們首先在合成混合物和使用確定性像素基於顏色獎勵的 SD3.5-M 上驗證了信用分配機制。然後，我們在感知外觀公平性上評估相同的目標。在三個自動評估器對保留提示的評估中，多軸 max@K 相對於基礎模型提高了公平性得分 0.23-0.36，同時保持圖像質量和文本對齊。
